frozen_scientific_scope.scope: Original low-poly interpretation of the preserved upper skull only. No mandible, teeth, neck, body, skin or inferred complete skeleton. Not a scan or exact specimen replica.
frozen_scientific_scope.era: Middle Miocene, Collón Curá Formation, Comallo, Río Negro, Argentina; formation attribution and approximately 15.7 Ma correlation follow original paper, not an exact specimen date.

notes: 716 mm is approximate in source. Postorbital width is calculated by doubling one side per table footnote.
Other depths/heights must be estimated from preserved multi-view plates, explicitly labelled artistic working dimensions, never asserted as measured anatomy.
Do not normalize the exported model to a unit cube. Neutral display support optional and excluded from skull measurements.

uncertainties: Specimen is dorsoventrally crushed. Preserve observed condition; no undeformed living skull reconstruction.
Most posterior palate is missing; only portions of left pterygoid/quadrate preserved. No mirrored complete posterior floor.
Original fossil has asymmetry and damage. Simplification is not an exact metrical replica or claim of complete anatomy.
Natural fossil colour in plates varies with lighting; chosen warm palette is artistic.

reference_credits.title: A new phorusrhacid (Aves: Cariamae) from the middle Miocene of Patagonia, Argentina
